snippet.title: Why Happy Gilmore Had To Change After Carl Weathers 🏌️💔
snippet.description:
In 1996, Carl Weathers created one of comedy's most beloved supporting characters when he played Chubbs Peterson, the one-handed golf mentor whose wisdom and wooden prosthetic gave Happy Gilmore much of its warmth. When Adam Sandler and his collaborators began developing a long-awaited sequel for Netflix, they planned to bring Weathers back and restore the partnership that had anchored the original film. His death in February 2024, at the age of 76, forced the creative team into a difficult reckoning, and Sandler later described the painful decision to rework the story around the absence of a figure he regarded as both a co-star and a friend. Rather than recasting the role or quietly writing Chubbs out, the filmmakers reshaped their approach to honor Weathers's legacy, turning a moment of loss into an act of tribute within the film itself. The episode showed how franchise revivals, so often treated as exercises in nostalgia, could become meditations on mortality and memory, and it confirmed that Weathers, already immortalized as Apollo Creed in Rocky, had left an equally enduring mark on a generation of comedy audiences.

snippet.title: How Engineers Build Metro Tunnels Beneath Skyscrapers! 😱🚇 | Underground Tunnel Construction
snippet.description:
Imagine a giant machine digging a metro tunnel right beneath crowded city buildings while people continue their daily lives above! 😱🏙️

How is this possible without damaging buildings, roads and other infrastructure?

Engineers use massive Tunnel Boring Machines (TBMs) to excavate underground tunnels with precision.

Here’s how it works:

🚇 1. Tunnel Boring Machine: Powerful rotating steel cutters excavate soil and rock underground.

🏗️ 2. Soil Stabilization: Engineers study underground conditions and use techniques such as ground grouting where necessary to strengthen weak soil.

📡 3. Building Protection: Sensors and surveying instruments monitor nearby buildings for ground movement and settlement.

🧱 4. Concrete Tunnel Lining: Special precast reinforced-concrete segments are installed behind the TBM to create a strong circular tunnel.

Finally, railway tracks, drainage, cables and other systems are installed before metro trains begin operating.

This is the incredible science behind underground metro construction and modern urban infrastructure!

snippet.title: Loving You Is Not a Sin 🥹❤️ | Zanjeerain | Sajal Aly x Danyal Zafar
snippet.description:
🥹❤️ She had prayed to forget him. He asked her to look into his eyes and say she didn't love him. She couldn't.

For days she had been trying to forget him. At her mama's house she had prayed for it. When he suddenly appeared at her reopened shop, she even feared he had come to end their paper nikah.

But when he recited the same shayari he had once begun on that night in the haveli, and laid his heart bare, she broke.

"Please, don't talk to me like this. I can't go down that path again. I can't be unfaithful to Mudassir. Please leave."

She turned to go.

He followed and stopped her.

"Fine, I'll go. But before I leave, look into my eyes and say just this: that you don't love me." 💔

She could no longer hold herself together. Tears poured from her eyes. She threw her arms around him and wept against his chest. 🥹

Moved, he said —

"Sometimes Allah writes such things into a person's fate that the person himself is left amazed. Today I've lightened my heart and confessed my love. I love you, Rabia. Now you say what is in your heart."

Crying, she said —

"I shouldn't have confessed my love to you. But I can't stop myself. I can't live without loving you. Still, there is always guilt in my heart. In your haveli I was Rabia, and you made me Saarmala. The girl standing before you now is Saarmala, who loves you without measure. Every night when I close my eyes, my last thought is of you, and every morning my first thought is of you. The harder I tried to forget you, the more it hurt."

He spoke gently —

"Rabia, if loving someone were a sin, I would consider myself guilty for loving you. But you lost Mudassir and I lost Sar Banu. Does that mean we can never love again? Perhaps Allah wrote it in our fate that we would be together like this. No one can understand our pain and our story better than the two of us."

He continued —

"You never told me to forget Sar Banu, because you know I will always remember her. It was in her memory that I wept with my head in your lap. And you, remembering Mudassir, cried on my shoulder. Just as you can't forget Mudassir, I can't forget Sar Banu. She remains in my heart, and she always will. But is it wrong that I love you too?" 😢

He reminded her how they had stood by each other.

"In the midst of our own pain, we tried to be each other's support. We shared secret tea from that old kettle you carried in a bucket. Through so much suffering and so many tears, we fell in love. There is nothing wrong in that, Rabia. Loving you is not a sin." 🥹❤️

His words reached her.

Her mama had told her she had every right to live and be happy. Bibijan had told him to step forward and bring her back.

Now her heart grew lighter, and she held him tighter. Tears kept flowing from both of them, but this time they held not only the pain of separation but the joy of finding each other.

At last, beyond the memories of the past, the pain of loss, and every doubt, they accepted their love. ❤️

Here the story of Sar Buland and Rabia ends.

THE END. 🥹❤️

snippet.title: [날씨/XR] 내일 전국 비..'10도 안팎' 풀린 날씨 / SBS 8뉴스
snippet.description:
날씨가 우중충합니다.

위성 영상을 보시면 중국 쪽에 거대한 하얀색의 구름대가 보이실 겁니다.

저기압인데요.

저기압의 전면부에서 비구름대가 발달하면서 제주와 남부 충청 지방에는 비가 내리고 있고요, 그 밖의 전국 하늘에도 구름이 가득 끼어 있습니다.

내일(14일)은 이 저기압이 우리나라를 통과하면서 전국에 비가 내리겠고 비는 밤에 서쪽 지역부터 점차 그치겠습니다.

비의 양은 남쪽 지방에 많겠습니다.

전남과 경남에 최대 40mm, 제주에 최고 60mm로 이맘때 비치고는 양이 많은 거고요, 수도권과 강원도에는 5~10mm, 그 밖의 지역 5~30mm의 비가 예상됩니다.

내일은 하늘 종일 흐리겠습니다.

앞서 보신 것처럼 구름이 밤사이에 이불 역할을 하면서 아침 기온은 크게 떨어지지는 않겠습니다.

서울이 10도 예상되고요, 낮 기온 서울이 14도, 광주가 17도로 오늘과 비슷하거나 조금 낮겠습니다.

비가 그쳐도 날이 갑자기 추워지지는 않겠습니다.

당분간은 평년 수준보다 높은 기온이 이어질 전망이고요, 일요일 밤부터 다음 주 월요일 사이에는 동해안에 비가 오겠고, 화요일과 수요일 사이에 또 전국에 비가 내릴 텐데 비가 그치고 나면 날이 확 추워질 전망입니다.

(남유진 기상예보사)

snippet.title: Boiled Egg Pizza Omelette🍳 | Easy & Delicious Egg Recipe | Cook With UmaDevi #Eggs #omelette #Pizza
snippet.description:
🍳 Boiled Egg Pizza Omelette – A Delicious & Unique Egg Recipe! 😍

Looking for a different and delicious way to enjoy eggs? Try this amazing Boiled Egg Vegetable Omelette! ❤️

Sliced boiled eggs are arranged in a pan, covered with a flavourful egg mixture and topped with colourful vegetables. Cooked until golden and perfectly set, this round egg omelette looks beautiful and tastes absolutely delicious!

Perfect for breakfast, evening snacks or a quick homemade meal. Simple ingredients, easy preparation and amazing taste!

🥚 Ingredients

* Boiled eggs, sliced
* Raw eggs, beaten
* Onion, finely chopped
* Tomato, finely chopped
* Green capsicum or green chillies, chopped
* Fresh coriander or herbs
* Salt to taste
* Black pepper powder
* Cooking oil

👩‍🍳 Preparation Method

Step 1: Prepare the Boiled Eggs
Boil the eggs, remove their shells and cut them into slices.

Step 2: Arrange the Eggs
Heat and lightly grease a pan. Arrange the boiled egg slices neatly inside the pan.

Step 3: Prepare the Egg Mixture
Crack fresh eggs into a bowl. Add salt and black pepper, then beat well.

Step 4: Pour the Egg Mixture
Pour the beaten egg mixture evenly over the arranged boiled egg slices.

Step 5: Add Vegetables
Sprinkle chopped onion, tomato, green capsicum and fresh coriander over the egg mixture.

Step 6: Cook the Omelette
Cover the pan and cook on a low flame until the egg mixture is completely set and the bottom turns golden.

Step 7: Serve
Carefully remove the omelette from the pan, place it on a serving plate and cut into pizza-style slices.

Your delicious Boiled Egg Pizza Omelette is ready! 😍🍳

snippet.title: CEPAT TONTON⚠️KALAU GAK KUAT TUTUP LAYAR..Kehidupan Suku Jawa Desa Terpencil Jawa Tengah
snippet.description:
kesempatan kali ini seperti biasa saya akan melanjut kan kembali petualangan saya menyusuri perkampungan Terpencil Terisolir kusus nya yang berada di jawa tengah ini untuk melihat kehidupan di desa, dan kita bisa menjumpai rumah klasik jawa yang masih terbuat bahan matrial nya dari bahan kayu jati dan masih terasa di kampung ini serasa kembali ke zaman dahulu terasa nyaman tentram damai.

Desa Wonotopo, kecamatan Candiroto, kabupaten Temanggung, provinsi jawa tengah.
kampung asri,sejuk,indah masih bernuansa zaman dulu era 1980an, di pedalaman hutan jati .

semoga ada nya tayangan ini bisa jadi hiburan,tuntunan,motivasi,inspirasi,edukasi dan mejadi obat rindu akan suasana kampung halaman seperti jaman dulu,yang masih asri,alami,tradisional,,serta kreatifitas budaya yang masih terjaga .

snippet.title: YOUR QUIET CALLING IS BIGGER THAN YOU THINK!
snippet.description:
Hebrews 6:10 (KJV) — 
“For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.”

YOUR QUIET CALLING IS BIGGER THAN YOU THINK! Not every assignment from God comes with a microphone, a platform, or public recognition. Hebrews 6:10 reminds us that God does not forget our work and labour of love. Whether you're serving others, encouraging someone, or faithfully obeying His Word, your efforts matter to Him. YOU DON'T HAVE TO BE FAMOUS TO BE FAITHFUL! GOD SEES WHAT OTHERS OVERLOOK!
